title: GovernanceResultEffector
description: Effector archetype for governance result emission. Typed by resultType (governance outcome verb). A governance result effector emits evaluation outcomes back into the governance fabric. Source: ITIP Meta-Governance Ontology; GSM Effector semantics.

resultType.description: Governance result discriminator. Identity-bound: effectors of the same Definition always emit the same result type. Source: ITIP meta-governance.
